conservation.help_by: Give wildlife space; pick reef-safe sunscreen and careful finning.
conservation.caution_against: Don’t feed fish, chase animals, or pocket living souvenirs.

life_info.eating: Live tissue of gorgonians. Mantle flaps cover the shell with leopard-like spots.
life_info.mating: Lays egg capsules on the same fans it grazes.
life_info.habitat: On soft corals and sea fans it slowly eats. Tiny living jewelry — look, don’t pocket.

fun_facts: The spots are soft mantle tissue, not paint on the shell.
When threatened, the mantle retracts and the shell looks plain cream.
